newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end up after trading in tight range.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end up after trading in tight range.

text.p: Manila shares ended up on Friday in a session which saw the index mired in a tight range and investors stayed away due to the Chinese New Year, traders said.
"The market was a bit cautious as volume was thinner. We are still in a consolidation period," said Harry Liu, president of Summit Securities.
The main index closed up 10.71 points, or 0.32 percent, at 3,381.84 points.
Value turnover was thin at 2.6 billion pesos. There were 69 gainers, 54 decliners and 79 unchanged issues.
Most of the gainers were small issues like Marsman & Co Inc, Marsteel Consolidated Inc and United Paragon Mining Corp.
Of the blue chips, Manila Electric B, First Philippine Holdings B and Metrobank posted gains while others were silent.
"I think we are going to pick up towards the middle of next week when players are back in the market," said Fitz Aclan, research head at Dharmala Securities Phils Inc.
